query:
# Every direct (best-rank) "shares border with" (P47) triple ?s wdt:P47 ?o
# that has a listed exception to the symmetric constraint on P47 as its
# subject or as its value. The exception items are read from the constraint
# statement, inside each branch.
#   ?role          whether the exception item is the subject or the value
#   ?reciprocated  whether the reverse direct triple ?o wdt:P47 ?s is present
# Replaces p47-exception-items-both-directions.rq, which timed out on
# 2026-11-14T15:52:34Z.
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX pq: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/qualifier/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>

SELECT ?exception ?exceptionLabel ?role ?s ?sLabel ?o ?oLabel ?reciprocated WHERE {
  {
    wd:P47 p:P2302 ?c .
    ?c ps:P2302 wd:Q21510862 .
    ?c pq:P2303 ?exception .
    ?exception wdt:P47 ?o .
    BIND(?exception AS ?s)
    BIND("subject" AS ?role)
  }
  UNION
  {
    wd:P47 p:P2302 ?c .
    ?c ps:P2302 wd:Q21510862 .
    ?c pq:P2303 ?exception .
    ?s wdt:P47 ?exception .
    BIND(?exception AS ?o)
    BIND("value" AS ?role)
  }
  BIND(EXISTS { ?o wdt:P47 ?s } AS ?reciprocated)
  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en" }
}
ORDER BY ?exception ?role ?s ?o
